correctness.rationale: The exact normalized covariance and symbolic derivative reduce the sign question to F_a(t). For a at or below the spectral edge, F is negative. Above it, F starts at zero with negative derivative, is strictly convex, and tends to infinity, proving a unique positive reversal. The implicit derivative yields strict monotonicity. Finite nuisance first moment gives the short-lag square-root constant, and the Laplace mass-edge hypothesis gives the exact logarithmic correction via a dominated-convergence argument. Numerical examples corroborate but do not prove any infinite statement.

The related 2023/2024 primary paper proves warning interference with shared driving noise, whereas this result uses independent target and nuisance and classifies derivative signs. A neuronal 2018 conference abstract discusses slow masking but no comparable exact rate/lag classification. Search and semantic comparisons found no dominating mathematical statement, with residual risk from differently indexed relaxation-spectrum literature.
